name: plan-pr
title: Plan PR
description: Prepare a grounded plan from a prompt or ticket, get human approval, implement with fixed design/TDD expertise, then hand off to Ship PR.
notes:
## Workflow

Read the request, tracker context and repository rules. Produce a concise plan with acceptance evidence and a fixed skill assignment. The same agent implements after approval; ship-pr-dev owns final validation, independent review, PR and CI.

## Setup

Optional shared repository Markdown config records tracker mapping, conventions and application launch/validation instructions. Credentials are referenced, never stored. Linear, GitHub, GitLab and other configured trackers use the same intake contract.

## Dependencies

All six skills are distributed with the workflow but invoked only when relevant. No runtime skill search or installation. Ship PR plan handoff tested against 1.5.1; design-frontend-dev against 3.1.1.

## Evaluation limits

Fixture-based planning comparisons cover seven situations; they do not constitute live Linear, browser or end-to-end PR validation.
